| `HeaderContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Rich header content (icons, badges, custom markup); overrides Header when set and renders a clickable toggle header. |
| `RegionLabel` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Accessible name for the content region, making it a named landmark a screen reader can jump to. A collapse with a built-in header already has one - its header - so this is for the headerless case, where the alternative is no landmark at all: an unnamed one is worse than none, because it appears in the landmark list with nothing to identify it by. Set it when the content is a distinct section of the page ("Advanced filters"); leave it null when the content is just more of what surrounds it. |
